the structure and activity of the enzyme acetylcholinisterase (AChE) can be altered by binding of small molecules, such as the Alzheimer drug E2020, and that the structure and function of the AChE molecule can be changed by mutations in the genes encoding the AChE protein.
E2020 is a potent inhibitor of AChE and BChE and is effective in reversing AChE-induced toxicity.
